extraction.notes: Company reports AFFO only (no Core FFO), so core fields are null. Starting line taken from the FFO note (GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders, $35,607). Zero-amount lines ('—') are included with 0. Diluted shares of 18,661 (thousands) from the Note 2 per-share table reproduce $0.20 FFO (3,774/18,661) and $0.37 AFFO (6,945/18,661); the income-statement diluted count of 17,726,343 is for GAAP EPS, not FFO. AFFO does not subtract recurring capex. Recurring capex from the Capital Expenditures table on the value-add/capex page (quarter ended June 30, 2022): BRT share $270,000 in full dollars, recorded as 270 in thousands; gross is $340,000 and JV partner share $70,000. Replacements ($661,000 BRT share) are expensed and not recorded as capex. Recurring capex is a property-level estimate, not a quarterly actual per se, though the table is labeled for the quarter.
